from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """One legal document with its title and the cause of action category it belongs to."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title, e.g., '《判决文书1》'")
    cause_of_action_category: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action category this document belongs to, extracted from the document content")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    legal_documents: list[LegalDocument]
